sections.sectionText: Virtual Immersion Trip to South Korea. Counts as a Specialization Capstone for iMBA students. Registration in this section is restricted to students admitted to the iMBA, iMSA, or iMSM degree programs. Course/Trip Fee is $575.00 ($475 will be charged to student's account, plus $100 deposit collected before registration).
In this project-based course, students will utilize immersive storytelling and transmedia play techniques to transform scenes from iconic plays and musicals into engaging, one-shot TTRPG experiences.
